entries.averment: A positive, specific sum is demanded, stated in both figures and words (they must match).
The act required of the recipient and the compliance period are stated (rule-driven, not model-written).
A specific consequence of non-compliance is stated (civil suit and/or criminal proceedings); a vague threat is insufficient.
Where a statutory minimum compliance period applies, the period stated is not below it.
Proof of dispatch is recorded on the notice (dispatch placeholder mandatory).
The notice is issued under the advocate's instructions from the client (authority averred).
